primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: First-order wavefront evolution and higher-order root separation are mathematical antecedents. The receiving full ordinary matrix diagonalization, polarized theorem and tube estimate are independently proved using exact programme components.

source_correspondence: D0-D1 retain the full scalar time-dependent wave principal form, all complex lower matrices, both actual Cauchy jets and the exact ordered balanced-pair system.

D2 proves the scalar gap bounds, smooth low-frequency extension, both parametrix defects, compulsory time connection, full Sylvester recurrence and all-time ordinary asymptotic summation. It does not commute matrix lower terms or assume their classical expansions.

D3 uses the exact two scalar-principal matrix evolutions with the Hamiltonians minus lambda. The oriented source integral retains its factor i. Every smoothing inverse/intertwining error is carried through the evolution in global Sobolev norms, including homogeneous time derivatives.
D4 supplies both microlocal Sobolev inclusions with the full polarized initial operator, compact-input/global-smooth-tail bounds and one fixed conic neighborhood for smooth wavefronts.

D5 requires an elliptic terminal test and regularity integrable along the entire transported source tube. Uniform separated graph estimates include the diagonal endpoint and all noncompact smooth tails.

D6 derives the full normalized Hamilton sign, parameter-dependent spacetime relation, actual Sobolev slice converse and branchwise elliptic reconstruction. It does not conflate the pair wavefront with the wavefront of a cancelling fixed-time position.

D7 connects the theorem to the exact incoming matrix solution. The source-tube condition for BPL sources and control of complementary boundary response remain separate, unproved receiving obligations.

All three exercises include complete solutions: the time connection and density factor, noncommuting ordered corrections and the two-jet delta solution. Twenty-four exact algebraic checks supplement the analytic proofs.
The original two-panel figure retains exact rays, time covectors and jump locations.
Twelve local proof entries bind to 1163 earlier entries in 60 maps, including 92 external Lebl providers.
